scope: Actual Projective Telepathy, Light Sense and Dark Sense nested during Anger reveal; zero/six destiny, adjacent insert and covered/exposed physical top.
method: A one-card production activation exposes a controlled-depth AFA insert. Actual Telepathy and two opposing Sense cards are played.
Covered controls place an ordinary destiny card above the already-revealed insert before the response chain. Exposed cases leave the physical insert on top.
Dark Sense completion records ordinary Reserve reduction, pending reveal status and adjacent visibility. Telepathy completion records cancellation outcomes and insert ownership/disposal.

Native-only tests additionally cover recovery, concession, generic ordinary movement destinations, a later insert exposed by the response and shared peek behavior. Peek code treats an already revealed insert as pending rather than a newly encountered insert.

adjudication.native: Responses draw ordinary Reserve cards while the revealed insert remains pending. Never draw, activate or lose an insert as Force; preserve its owner and delayed reveal order.
adjudication.gemp: DrawDestinyEffect uses GameState.getTopOfReserveDeck without filtering a revealed insert. In all four uncovered cases it draws AFA as destiny and later places it in Dark Used; an adjacent insert reveals early. Covered controls match native.
adjudication.source: AR p167 explicitly prohibits using inserts as destiny or Force. Native follows that rule; the four mismatches are retained as evidence, not parity.

limitations: Production full-match deck admission remains closed; full catalog, setup, formats, ships/vehicles, CPU/PvP/capacity and full-match certification remain.

Shuffling a Reserve containing a pending revealed insert remains guarded until its physical continuation semantics are implemented and verified. Full normal-activation reference traces and multi-card movement integration remain.

Shared peek primitives have native regression coverage here, not an actual new response-granting peek card or fresh GEMP replacement trace. Prior nine peek replacement disagreements remain documented separately.
